svg.metadata: Wales target: 22 ONS/Ordnance Survey 2016 local authority geometries (UK-GeoJSON, OGL v3), dissolved and simplified at 0.6 map pixels, keeping Anglesey and Holy Island as separate islands. Context: Natural Earth 1:10m map subunits (public domain), dissolved and clipped to the full canvas. WGS84 local-equirectangular-fit-v1; label callouts retain verified real anchors. Geometry sources: https://github.com/martinjc/UK-GeoJSON/blob/master/json/administrative/wal/lad.json ; https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/master/geojson/ne_10m_admin_0_map_subunits.geojson
